name: Travel and transport for work (reimbursed)
authority: Revenue Code s.42(1): travelling allowances paid for the performance of work are exempt; Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 s.73: the employer bears transport for work away from the usual locality. Reimbursed at cost, outside PND1, SSO and WCF. Office of the Council of State English translation (https://www.vertic.org/media/National%20Legislation/Thailand/TH_Labor_Protection_Act.pdf).
